name: Antarctica

flag.description: A dark blue field with a white map of Antarctica in the centre, set in a white grid of lines of latitude and longitude.
flag.symbolism: The map and its grid show the continent that the treaty sets aside for peace and science.

hook: Antarctica's treaty flag is a white map of the continent caught in a web of latitude and longitude lines on dark blue.
trivia: The Antarctic Treaty was signed in Washington, D.C. on 1 December 1959 by twelve countries and came into force in 1961.
Antarctica has no single official flag; this emblem of the treaty system is the one most often flown for it.
